..description: Single installable T3 Mission Mode application: shared transactional kernel, CLI/MCP bridge, native lock, and local HTTP/SSE HUD.

lint_config.rationale: ESLint recommended rules plus unused-variable, async, equality, and unreachable-code checks cover all JS/MJS source and tests.

type_check.rationale: Static checked JavaScript covers the actual HTTP security, logging, diagnostics, and route boundary; broader legacy typing is explicit debt.

formatter.rationale: Prettier formatting is configured and checked across supported repository files.

pre_commit_hooks.rationale: Checked-in pre-commit hook runs the quality gate and is enabled through this checkout-local hooksPath.

strict_typing.rationale: The checked operations boundary enables strict, unchecked-index, and exact-optional-property checks without suppressions.

naming_consistency.rationale: AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING specify camelCase functions, PascalCase classes, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constants, kebab-case modules, and test names.

cyclomatic_complexity.rationale: AST complexity analysis enforces maximum 20 for new functions and frozen per-function legacy ceilings; metrics and owned debt are retained.

large_file_detection.rationale: Quality checks reject tracked/untracked project files above 2 MiB; negative probes verified rejection.

dead_code_detection.rationale: Unused imports/locals are detected across JS/MJS, existing dead helpers were removed, and negative verification proved rejection.

duplicate_code_detection.rationale: jscpd scans production JS modules, enforces a 1% duplication ceiling, and emits reviewable metrics.

code_modularization.rationale: An architectural fitness check rejects forbidden imports across kernel, bridge, HUD, operations, and native modules.

tech_debt_tracking.rationale: Owned debt entries have closure conditions; the quality checker rejects orphan TODO/FIXME/HACK references.

n_plus_one_detection.rationale: No database or ORM; durable state remains JSON files and a filesystem WAL.

build_cmd_doc.rationale: README and development guide document native build/setup with local compiler and Node headers.

deps_pinned.rationale: Exact direct tool versions, integrity hashes, transitive resolutions, and security override pins are committed.

vcs_cli_tools.rationale: gh is authenticated and can read this repository, including admin permission metadata.

automated_pr_review.rationale: No actual bot-generated PR review comments exist; check-only workflows do not satisfy review generation.

agentic_development.rationale: The maintained packaged skill actively directs agent implementation, isolated work, and validation handoffs.

fast_ci_feedback.rationale: There are still no merged PR check timestamps establishing average primary CI feedback below ten minutes.

build_performance_tracking.rationale: Native setup/package durations are explicitly measured; CI retains build-timings artifacts and npm caching.

deployment_frequency.rationale: Release automation is configured, but no release/deployment history establishes multiple successful weekly deployments.

single_command_setup.rationale: A documented npm ci/setup/qa sequence builds the native lock and runs an isolated development target.

feature_flag_infrastructure.rationale: Permanent default-off allowLocalDaemon switch is wired into runtime adapter construction.

release_notes_automation.rationale: Tagged release workflow generates GitHub release notes; a bounded git-log notes CLI also exists.

progressive_rollout.rationale: Not an infrastructure repository; this remains a locally installed developer tool.

rollback_automation.rationale: Not an infrastructure-based repository; local package rollback is documented but this infra-only signal is N/A.

monorepo_tooling.rationale: Single-application repository with one root package and one shared installation lifecycle.

heavy_dependency_detection.rationale: Non-bundled Node service/CLI with static browser assets; the stated non-bundled application N/A applies.

unused_dependencies_detection.rationale: Knip checks dependencies/binaries/unlisted references against actual runtime, scripts, and test entrypoints; only the documented system compiler is external.

version_drift_detection.rationale: One build package/module; sibling-module dependency drift is inapplicable.

release_automation.rationale: A tag-triggered release pipeline validates, packs, verifies the extracted archive, checksums, and publishes it. Historical deployment success is not claimed.

dead_feature_flag_detection.rationale: Permanent flag ownership, callers, release review, and dead-backend/alias removal conditions are documented.

unit_tests_exist.rationale: Extensive meaningful node:test cases cover the application, including new HTTP/security/diagnostic regressions.

integration_tests_exist.rationale: Integration suites exercise recovery, native storage, CLI/MCP, and running HTTP services; legacy handler fixtures now use real loopback requests.

unit_tests_runnable.rationale: The full suite runs through npm test, but this rubric requires TS/JS native listing/collection. The Node runner has no such mode; the direct attempt fails without executing tests.

test_performance_tracking.rationale: The runner writes per-run timing and JUnit per-test results; CI retains timing/coverage/stability artifacts for review.

flaky_test_detection.rationale: A configured CI stability check compares two independent security/runtime-boundary runs, retains results, and never hides a failed attempt.

test_coverage_thresholds.rationale: The real npm test entrypoint passes the enforced 80% lines/functions and 70% branches thresholds on Linux ARM64 with tmpfs fixtures; macOS/APFS and live provider evidence remain separate.

test_naming_conventions.rationale: The runner explicitly discovers only *.test.mjs behavior suites, matching documented conventions.

test_isolation.rationale: Node process isolation, bounded concurrency, unique per-suite evidence/TMPDIR, and success cleanup prevent shared fixture state.

interactive_qa_exists.rationale: Complete standalone QA documents local compiler/headers, setup, no credentials/transport, ephemeral launch, actual state/settings interaction, and cleanup.

interactive_qa_runnable.rationale: Fresh execution of the target QA entrypoint completed real loopback HTML/health/state/settings/metrics interactions in an external temporary workspace.

agents_md.rationale: Root AGENTS.md documents actual setup/build/check/test/QA commands, conventions, storage fences, and evidence limits.

readme.rationale: Root README documents installation, usage, native build, development, and diagnostics.

automated_doc_generation.rationale: API reference and OpenAPI are generated from runtime route metadata and actual MCP schemas; drift checks pass.

skills.rationale: Packaged skill has valid frontmatter and substantive agent workflow; root and packaged copies are byte-identical.

documentation_freshness.rationale: Current commit updates README, AGENTS, and CONTRIBUTING within 180 days.

api_schema_docs.rationale: A generated valid OpenAPI document describes actual HUD routes, JSON/SSE contracts, errors, command bodies, and request correlation.

service_flow_documented.rationale: Mermaid diagram and transaction design docs explain T3 host transport, bridge, kernel, HUD, and durable storage.

agents_md_validation.rationale: Automation verifies AGENTS npm commands/local links, generated docs, and skill synchronization; CI runs its documented workflows.

devcontainer.rationale: No devcontainer configuration exists; native Node/C setup is used without Docker.

env_template.rationale: Nonsecret environment template and docs explain exported paths, optional transport/notification variables, and default-off local execution.

local_services_setup.rationale: Development docs explicitly identify optional T3 transport and provide a complete mock-free local HTTP QA path without credentials or external services.

database_schema.rationale: No database; the application uses public JSON files, checksummed WAL records, and OS file locks.

devcontainer_runnable.rationale: The devcontainer CLI is not installed; its stated skip condition applies.

structured_logging.rationale: A dedicated JSON logger is wired into HTTP errors and scrubs sensitive nested context before stderr output.

distributed_tracing.rationale: Validated request IDs correlate HTTP responses/errors; existing clientRequestId/invocationId propagate through T3 actions and durable receipts.

metrics_collection.rationale: Live Prometheus metrics report bounded route/status counts, duration sums, uptime, and local feature-use counters.

code_quality_metrics.rationale: CI retains enforced coverage, per-function complexity, duplication, timing, and stability reports; current local metrics are readable.

error_tracking_contextualized.rationale: Local redacted error rings/stacks and request IDs are implemented, but no full error tracker with source maps, user context, and breadcrumbs is configured.

alerting_configured.rationale: No enabled automatic alert-rule/trigger/notifier delivery chain exists. Stderr errors and optional command webhooks are not operational alert proof.

runbooks_documented.rationale: Agent instructions link a dedicated operational runbook covering installation impact, transaction faults, receipts, HTTP errors, and rollback.

deployment_observability.rationale: Runbook identifies health/readiness/metrics/diagnostics views for comparing installed release impact and states their runtime limits.

health_checks.rationale: Actual liveness/readiness endpoints run on the local service; readiness reads a consistent snapshot and reports unavailable storage separately.

circuit_breakers.rationale: Existing provider resilience honors Retry-After, bounded exponential backoff, and a persistent consecutive-failure budget.

profiling_instrumentation.rationale: Configured development CPU profiling runs 100 real snapshot reads and settings QA, writing a local .cpuprofile without telemetry export.

branch_protection.rationale: Admin access exists; active rulesets are absent and main remains unprotected. Direct-push delivery was requested.

secret_scanning.rationale: GitHub native secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and the alerts API succeeds.

codeowners.rationale: CODEOWNERS assigns the actual repository owner across the project.

automated_security_review.rationale: CodeQL SARIF and readable dependency-audit automation are configured, but GitHub returns no analysis and no actual automated security report has been published yet; keep this signal failed until one exists.

dependency_update_automation.rationale: Renovate is configured with exact grouped delayed updates, but no actual updater-created dependency PR exists yet.

gitignore_comprehensive.rationale: Ignore rules cover env secrets, dependencies, IDE/OS files, coverage/reports/packages, and native build outputs; the example remains available.

dast_scanning.rationale: Automatic CI runs custom security attacks against an actual ephemeral HTTP service: cross-origin/Host spoofing, invalid JSON, body bounds, and data leakage.

pii_handling.rationale: Developer utility without personal end-user data processing; documented scrubbing does not change the rubric explicit developer-utility N/A.

privacy_compliance.rationale: Developer utility with no end-user data collection; aggregate diagnostics stay local and collect no user identity. The explicit developer/internal-tool N/A applies.

secrets_management.rationale: Workflows use scoped GitHub secrets; env secrets are ignored with a nonsecret template and handling guidance.

log_scrubbing.rationale: Logger and bounded error retention redact credential fields, token-shaped IDs, emails, bearer values, and common local paths; behavior tests verify it.

min_release_age.rationale: Renovate and CONTRIBUTING require a seven-day routine dependency delay; documented security exceptions require advisory evidence.

issue_templates.rationale: Structured bug and feature issue forms require reproduction/evidence or acceptance details.

issue_labeling_system.rationale: Actual repository labels now include P0-P3 priorities, bug/feature/chore types, and kernel/bridge/HUD/native/tooling/documentation areas.

backlog_health.rationale: No open issues exist, so actual evidence cannot establish the required >70% descriptive-and-labeled issue ratio.

pr_templates.rationale: PR template requires the change, tested layer/commands/SHA, and review/rollback context.

product_analytics_instrumentation.rationale: The rubric requires an instrumented product analytics platform such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog, Heap, or GA4. Aggregate local counters are useful diagnostics but do not meet that requirement.

error_to_insight_pipeline.rationale: No error-tracker-to-issue automation is configured; security artifacts and local error rings do not create issues from runtime errors.
